Name: Elhanan, Son of Dodo
Summary: Elhanan, son of Dodo of Bethlehem, was among David's thirty mighty men. He is distinct from Elhanan son of Jaare-oregim, who slew a giant at Gob.
KeyStory: Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem stood among David's thirty.
LifeLesson: Two Elhanans, two stories — Bethlehem gave David more than one hero.
